title: The Rights of Children upon Their Parents in Islam

text_simplified: This text discusses the rights of children upon their parents in Islam, mentioning Prophetic hadiths that urge the proper tarbiyah (upbringing) of children. It also highlights that the righteousness of children reflects upon their parents in this world and the Hereafter. It emphasizes the importance of making du'a for one's children and showing them care and concern.
